recipients.title: Alert recipients
recipients.description: E-mail addresses and international phone numbers (+ or 00 first; phones get WhatsApp or SMS), up to 20.

staffPermission.title: Also alert Accounts staff who can
staffPermission.description: Every unblocked Accounts user whose role has this Ecommerce permission (needs the Accounts token). Empty = only the list above.

adminUrl.title: Order page in your admin
adminUrl.description: With {number} and {id}, for example https://admin.shop.com/orders/{id}. Alerts link to it.
